title: Union Carbide Corporation v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Union Carbide Corporation v. Union of India, (1991) 4 SCC 584 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Upheld the $470 million civil settlement for Bhopal gas victims and affirmed the principle that multi-national enterprises carrying out hazardous operations in developing countries bear strict economic accountability.
content.relevance: Affirmed mass tort compensation and prompted the enactment of the Public Liability Insurance Act, 1991.
